notes.title: Update 5.1
notes.notes:
We’re excited to present a new Modding Support Update! 


🛠️ What’s New for Modding?

- A Mods folder is now automatically created when launching the game for the first time – making mod installation easier than ever.  
- All detected mods are now listed in the log.txt for better transparency.  
- If a level fails to load, you’ll now see a clear error message via popup instead of falling endlessly through the void.  
- Mods can no longer overwrite each other – mod conflicts like this should be a thing of the past.

The newest Modding SDK can be found here: \[GitHub](https://github.com/SimuverseInteractive/SubwaySim2-ModdingSDK)

Heads-up:  
If your mods include custom classes (e.g. Signals, DataTables, etc.), you may need to make some small adjustments in Blueprints to ensure they work correctly after this update. More details can be found on Discord.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/1a703b70984cdcf3a15b0d60fe22af3775de8825.jpg"]
🎉 U-Bahn Sim Berlin – Update

Alongside this update, a new sneak-peek version of U-Bahn Sim Berlin is being released. Thanks to thorough testing and great teamwork, we were able to fix additional bugs, making the modding experience even smoother. Be sure to check out this fantastic project!


⚠️ Known Issue:

Mods currently don’t work with the Epic Games version of SubwaySim 2 and will cause the game to crash. We're actively working on a fix and appreciate your patience in the meantime.

notes.title: Subway Sim 2 | Update 5 | Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've just released a new update for SubwaySim 2! 🎉

This patch includes a variety of improvements to vehicle logic, weather effects, and lighting – including fixes for DT5 train behavior, tunnel environments, and several station details.



You can find the full list of changes below in the changelog.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback – enjoy the ride! 🚇



🔧 Update 5 – Full Patch Notes 🔧



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/d224a51b25839a85759c827da9c2e9a59fc758f9.png"]

🌟 Highlights

🧩 Adjusted shadow settings
➜ May improve performance on many systems

🌩️ Lightning and thunder now blocked in tunnels
➜ Weather effects now react realistically to tunnels for improved immersion
[hr][/hr]🚆 Vehicles
🚪 DT5 – Automatic door closing fixed
➜ Doors now close as intended

💡 DT5 – Passenger area lighting improved
➜ Interior lighting now responds dynamically to environmental conditions (e.g., entering tunnels), using track data – more accurate and efficient

🌧️ All vehicles – Weather effects now use track data
➜ Effects like wetness, lighting changes, and sound now react more precisely to tunnel and weather conditions

🧼 DT5 DMI – Wiper mode renamed
➜ “Automatic” is now called “Interval” for clearer function description

🚪 HK & A3L92 – Cabin door animation glitch fixed
➜ Fixed an issue where the last frame of the animation briefly appeared when opening/closing
[hr][/hr]🌆 Environment & Effects
🌫️ Tunnel lighting at Krumme Lanke fixed
➜ Tunnel at the end of the turnaround area was too bright

🌩️ Lightning effects blocked in tunnels
➜ No visible or audible lightning/thunder inside tunnels anymore

🌧️ Rain sounds removed in tunnels
➜ When the vehicle is fully inside a tunnel, rain sounds are no longer audible

🧩 Improved shadow rendering
➜ General settings revised for better performance
[hr][/hr]🚉 Stations
🏙️ Mönckebergstraße – Lighting and billboard fix
➜ Improved general station lighting and fixed stretched advertisement textures.

🪜 Uhlandstraße – Ladder positioning corrected
➜ Fixed the position of a misaligned ladder.

👤 Hauptbahnhof Süd – NPC platform fix
➜ NPCs no longer fall through platform sections – improved collision handling.

💡 Update now and experience the improvements yourself!

notes.title: Subway Sim 2 | Update 4
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/c8283e625ffd8fefb96b884bdd797fe7d0ba2971.png"]

A new update is now available for SubwaySim 2, bringing a variety of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements to gameplay, sound and visuals. Highlights include the option to skip siding track wait times, more accurate HUD distance display, new brake sounds for HK and A3L92. Timetable services now support depot runs, and multiple visual and sound glitches have been addressed to improve immersion and realism. 



Gameplay Improvements

Added option to skip waiting times on siding tracks in both Career and Scenario mode.

Objective list now updates correctly when continuing after the debriefing screen.

HK trains no longer prompt for IBIS code entry within the same station.

HK trains will now correctly prompt for IBIS entry on service runs ("Z6NE").

The displayed distance in the HUD now reflects actual distance along the rail tracks.

Signals towards Uhlandstraße siding tracks now correctly display Hp4 instead of Hp3.

"Night Owl" and "Early Bird" achievements can now be triggered as intended.

When selecting services in timetable mode, the corresponding depot runs are now included.

An icon has been added to indicate if a service starts or ends in the depot.

The game no longer prompts to deactivate the cab before the debriefing if it will need to be re-activated immediately after.

Timetable mode shifts can now be continued after restoring from a savegame.

Improved detection of turnarounds at the start of scenarios.



Sound & Visual Improvements

Fixed cut-off door sounds for DT5, HK, and A3L92 trains.

Added spring brake sounds for HK and A3L92.

Added electro-pneumatic brake sounds for HK.

Fixed HK LOD models – approaching vehicles now display correct meshes.

DT5 IBIS buttons now dim when pressed.

Improved flickering glass effects on DT5.

Increased brightness of passenger lights, cab screens, and cab buttons.

BR 474 color correction applied.

Fixed flipped interior decals in HK.

Added missing decal for A3L92.



Localization Fixes

Fixed incorrect female career rank localization in German.



Scenarios & Services 

Berlin Weather Chaos scenario no longer requires a login at the final passenger stop.

Fixed missing timetables for Warschauer Straße on Sunday evenings. Environment & Infrastructure

Reduced flickering on:

Ballastless track

Superstructure fences,

Sleepers (via new LODs),

Fixed normals on road junctions.

Fixed road spline issues – vehicles should no longer stutter.

Fixed road vehicle collision issues on bridges (vehicles no longer interfere with those beneath).

Improved performance of road traffic.

Adjusted speed limit near Berliner Tor (coming from Lübecker Straße) from 50 km/h to 30 km/h.

Berliner Tor siding tracks 11–14 are now labeled 41–44.

Moved signal near Wittenbergplatz that was previously stuck inside a wall.



We hope you enjoy Update 4 and have a great weekend!

notes.title: What you Get in the Next Update
notes.notes:
Our next update is just around the corner – and once again, it brings a number of improvements based on your feedback. Here's a quick look at some of the highlights!


New Brake Sounds for HK and A3L92
With the upcoming update, the HK and A3L92 trains will receive new, authentic spring brake sounds. These provide a much more realistic acoustic experience when parking the trains. Also new for the HK: the electro-pneumatic brake system now features the characteristic switching sounds of the EP brake. This adds an extra layer of depth to train handling – especially when braking gently.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/c49b50ec3534b33afe67c25fc6ff4fd628f54c69.jpg"]
Depot Trips and Achievements
A popular request is finally coming true – you’ll soon be able to drive your train into the depot at the end of a shift. Wrapping up the day (or handing off to the night crew) will feel much more immersive. The “Night Owl” and “Early Bird” achievements weren’t working as intended – this is now fixed. Time to complete your trophy collection!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/8fca0642f184fc3bd069feea3f1fbbcf69df0239.jpg"]
HUD Distance Display & Track Flickering
The HUD's distance display will now show the distance from the front of the train instead of the camera position. This gives you a much better sense of train positioning – especially when stopping precisely at the platform or during shunting movements.  
Another technical refinement: flickering on ballastless tracks, fence edges, and sleepers has been significantly reduced. The environment now looks much calmer and easier on the eyes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/1cf68dc31873271648d9525013203d30472f4f72.jpg"]

The full changelog with more fixes and improvements is coming soon – so stay tuned. In the meantime, we’re always happy to hear your feedback! Let us know what you think of the game, share your screenshots, report bugs, and send us your ideas. Together, we can make the game even better.


About SubwaySim 2


SubwaySim 2 is now available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. We’d love to hear your thoughts in the Steam Discussions, on our Discord server, or via Instagram. Also check out the game on the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, or Epic Games Store!

A new update is available for you, bringing several Quality of Life improvements, including enhanced tunnel lighting and reduced environmental flickering.

Highlights

 Tunnels are no longer affected by external lighting
 Improved light reflections on windshields

General & Gameplay

 The statistics now show the player's total career experience
 Numerical values in the statistics have been formatted for better clarity
 Scenarios now show an icon if they have been completed at least once
 The station selection now responds reliably, even with very long repaint compositions
 A potential bug, where audio could cut out during gameplay, has been fixed
 The positions of individual signs on Saarlandstraße have been corrected
 A faulty track behind the "T21 BA" signal in Barmbek has been fixed


Vehicles & Technology

 Interactive sunshades added for the vehicle types HK and A3L92
 The issue with incorrect direction or missing weather effects on some vehicle windows has been fixed

 Wiper sounds have been equipped with spatial audio playback
 Wiper switch positions have been correctly labeled
 IBIS table in the DT5 driver's cab has been updated
 The electric brake of the DT5 has been adjusted – braking distance is now about 20% shorter


Technology & Graphics

 DirectX 11 is now recommended via a startup window for certain AMD GPUs to avoid potential crashes
 A new sharpness option is available in the graphics settings
 Higher settings for "Foliage Quality" now increase the render range of trees
 Field of View and Motion Blur can now be adjusted on consoles
 You can now use a keyboard in the menu on consoles

notes.title: A Look Ahead at the Next Update
notes.notes:
Day by day, we’re receiving an incredible amount of positive feedback from you. Thank you for your overwhelming support! We’re extremely grateful for this response – and it motivates us even more to continue working on improvements behind the scenes.

While we don’t have a finished update for you this week, we’d like to take you on a quick behind-the-scenes tour and show you what you can expect from SubwaySim 2 in the near future.

Introducing: Update 3

We’ve received numerous bug reports via Steam and Discord and are working hard to address as many of your requests as possible, step by step. With Update 3, we’re tackling some of the bigger topics.

New Tunnel Lighting

Many of you have asked us to revisit the tunnel lighting. On one hand, low sun positions often caused lighting artifacts inside tunnels. On the other hand, tunnels weren’t as dark as intended, especially on lower settings.

We’ve completely reworked the lighting system in tunnel areas. Tunnels are now rendered independently of time of day and weather. We’re currently testing these changes in our internal beta – and the first impression is very positive.

Improved Windows

We’ve frequently heard reports of flickering windshields and windows on certain devices. While addressing this, we also fixed issues with rain effects on some side windows (wrong direction or invisible from the inside). Both improvements are currently being tested thoroughly in our beta. We’re excited to hear your feedback once it’s live.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/daa83b6f08bd5b15c2bd984fbf947b8f8f11c9da.jpg

Improved Tree Rendering

Another frequent request was for trees on higher graphics settings to switch to lower resolution models later. We’ve made improvements here as well – take a look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/9fac7aa50b1f7883ad616ec52d7b7745d52d9d4d.jpg

Anti-Aliasing (Flickering)

Let’s move on to the next visual topic. On some systems, we observed noticeable anti-aliasing artifacts, especially around bridges and city areas with lots of buildings.

To improve this, we’re implementing several changes:

 DLSS anti-aliasing for compatible NVIDIA graphics cards
 Adjusted LODs (Level of Detail) for affected assets, especially bridges
 Improvements to the track structure to reduce flickering
 And more


We can’t say for sure which of these fixes will make it into Update 3 just yet. Since many of you brought up flickering and anti-aliasing, we’re also taking a closer look at the sleepers.

Modding

Many in the community have been eagerly awaiting the modding SDK, which will finally allow you to build your own vehicles and routes. We’re already in the testing phase and hope to give you the green light for building very soon. Please bear with us just a little longer – it’s almost time!

DLSS & FSR

Wait… didn’t we mention DLSS above? That’s right – in addition to anti-aliasing, DLSS also functions as an upscaling method. For compatible GPUs (NVIDIA RTX 20xx and newer), we’re working on DLSS support that should also improve performance. We’re also looking into FSR – the AMD counterpart to DLSS – for systems that aren’t DLSS-compatible. While we can’t yet confirm when either will be ready, both are on our priority list.

Performance

Let’s get to the most important topic: performance. Of course, we’re also working on improvements here. However, since we need to test across all platforms (PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S), it’s a time-consuming process – and the main reason why we can’t deliver a finished update this week.

When will the update be released?

Due to recent changes, we especially need to optimize further on Xbox before we can release the update. Performance on Xbox is currently more challenging than on the other platforms. If issues persist, we may consider releasing Update 3 for PC and PlayStation first, and delivering the Xbox version slightly later. We’ll let you know more about this next week.

In the meantime, we’re still happy to receive your feedback. Let us know what you think of the game – share your screenshots, report bugs, and keep your ideas coming. You’re helping us make the game even better together.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/06598be24c8e1dbb80ebdd755e278ae5baa9aa7e.jpg

About SubwaySim 2

SubwaySim 2 is now available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. We’d love to hear your thoughts in the Steam Discussions, on our Discord server, or via Instagram. Also check out the game on the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, or Epic Games Store!

notes.title: SubwaySim 2 | Second Patch | Available Now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/b05ad15b6cd43fa5818853540c616b7a6f3f5f88.png

Hey everyone!
Time for another update – but first, a huge thank you to all of you!  ❤️ 
On release day, an incredible 1,191 people were in the game at the same time – insane! 🥳  We see every day how much fun you’re having with the game. Really cool – this wouldn’t have been possible without you. Thank you for that!
Thank you for your amazing feedback! We’ll be implementing many of your suggestions in the upcoming updates. 💪 

▶️ Performance & Graphics
Added more max framerate options.
"Framerate Off" now fully unlocks the framerate.
River visuals improved on medium settings.

▶️ Career Mode
Save files now show as "Career" saves.
Predicted playtime now matches actual duration.
Sessions can end at any station with takeovers; player walks to despawn point.
Interactables can be used until the train departs.

▶️ Train & Station Logic
AI trains no longer take passengers into sidings.
Depot doors now block the player.
ELA request for automatic announcements triggers only at platforms.
HK can now unlock doors in B and C coaches above 40 km/h.
Fixed broken track at Uhlandstraße Track 8.
Adjusted door audio for Berlin vehicles.

▶️ Signaling & Infrastructure
Fixed Signal Gleisdreieck R2.
Corrected Daisy configuration at Uhlandstraße and Kurfürstendamm.
Aligned Fahrsperre with sleepers.
Shortened third rail at Nollendorfplatz.

▶️ Visuals & Meshes
Fixed culling issue on BR474.
A3L92 mesh fixes.
Möckernbrücke station adjustments.

▶️ Localization
Added missing translations for track plans in Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, and Portuguese.

notes.title: SubwaySim 2 | First Patch | Available Now
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159567/05635811ea8155979efd5848f0d73ab7247d9338.png

After the successful launch of SubwaySim 2, we're excited to release our first patch, addressing some of the valuable feedback we've already received from the community!
If you're enjoying the game, we’d really appreciate it if you took a moment to leave a review on Steam. Your feedback not only means a lot to us, but it also helps us continue improving the game for everyone.

Here's the changelog: 


 Added horn functionality for HK and A3L92 vehicles
    Players can now activate the horn via the standard control keybinding.

 HK: Fixed non-functional wiper in the D coach
    The wiper now animates correctly and responds to weather changes.

 A3L92: Corrected misaligned couplings between cars
    Couplings now connect seamlessly and maintain proper visual alignment.
